title: FIRE前にやるべきこと10選｜クレカ・ローン・保険・口座を総点検
meta_description: FIRE前にやっておきたい10項目を、クレカ・ローン・保険・銀行口座・信用の順に総点検。30歳・資産6,000万円で会社を辞めた経験と、資産の増減を経て考えた、支払いが止まらない仕組みを整理します。
lead: クレカを何枚作るかより、退職後も支払いが止まらず、家族が見ても迷わない仕組みを作ることが先です。ローン・保険・口座・信用を、残す・見直す・確認するの3つに分けて点検します。
thumbnail_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: 1:1 square Japanese article thumbnail for a FIRE credit-and-contract audit article. Input Image 1 is the exact anime character reference. Preserve the character's black hair, black-frame glasses, white FIRE shirt, face identity and clean anime illustration style, but freely change the pose and facial expression. Scene: a large three-dimensional control board with four clearly separated zones for a plain credit card, a loan balance gauge, an insurance shield and three blank bank-account tiles; include check marks, a magnifier and a route arrow, but no card numbers or personal data. Character performance: skeptical but composed, one eyebrow raised, narrowed eyes, lips slightly pursed, no smile. Pose: standing in a wide three-quarter stance, one hand holding a magnifying glass toward the contracts and the other hand moving a red keep/review marker across the board, exactly two arms and two hands, natural anatomy. Integrate these exact large Japanese headline texts with crisp legible typography and strong outlines: 「10項目を総点検」 and 「FIRE前の信用」. Relevant smaller category labels may appear on the four zones, but no random text. Vivid yellow, red, teal, white and deep navy. Use a bold radial/diagonal composition distinct from the first article; the text should be integrated into the illustration, not pasted on later. One character only. No real name, address, phone number, email, personal data, brand logo, watermark, extra limbs, extra hands, malformed fingers, or illegible main text.
